independentShells.player:
Edit the reference artwork into ONE standalone independent World of Warcraft Retribution Paladin unit-frame HUD shell. The reference is ONLY a material and shape language reference; the two units must NOT be connected or appear together. Output exactly ONE shell on real transparent alpha, landscape canvas approximately 2.2:1, clean edges with no colored matte/red/yellow fringe. No opaque background and no checkerboard. Keep the same classic Warcraft III / early WoW painterly substantial armor, silver wings, aged gold trim, ivory stone/inlays, sun/lion/Light emblem, integrated hammer or sword, and dark dimensional material shading. Make the overall outer contour irregular, about 1.4x the width and 1.5x the height of its functional region. Keep the artwork large/readable, not micro-detailed.
No rectangular outer border, square corner frame, giant backplate, text, health bars, unit portraits, UI icons, or duplicate floating crest. The portrait hole, bar opening, name area and all surrounding negative space must be actual transparency. No connecting bridge, cloth, weapon shaft, chain, or ornament toward another unit. All ornament must terminate within this one self-contained asset. Leave at least a 3% transparent margin all around.
PLAYER shell: portrait on LEFT, bars extending RIGHT. Treat the canvas as a 330x150 unit layout. Circular/teardrop portrait aperture center at (103,74), clear diameter 70. The bar opening is x=131..267, y=62..101, entirely clear. Name clearance x=132..267, y=40..62 must also remain clear; don't put a top rail across the name. A bold silver wing and lion/sun armor embrace the LEFT outside of the portrait, with a short downward tapered hammer/cathedral plate at lower left. Long subtle sculpted support beneath the bar region ends at a small outward sword-shaped point on the far right. Do not draw any second portrait or lower target shell. Preserve a balanced strong silhouette around this exact opening geometry.

Polished silver feather wing rising on the far left; aged gold edging; ivory feather and stone inlays; a crown-like sunburst above a circular portrait rim; a slim tapering silver/gold support extending to the right for two native bars; one small sun-star tip at the right end. No second shell or connection to another frame.
Precise clearances on a conceptual 330 by 150 layout: portrait aperture center (103,74), clear diameter 70. A horizontal bar aperture from x=124 to 267 and y=62 to 103 joins the circle. At least 4% transparent padding so no wing tips touch the canvas. Metal is opaque; empty holes and outside are genuinely transparent. No checkerboard pattern, printed transparency grid, labels, icons, portrait content, health bars, background color, large glow cloud, or opaque panel.
